carpet.rule.slimeBlockNoPlayerBounce.nam: Hardened Slime Block: No Player Bounce
carpet.rule.slimeBlockNoPlayerBounce.des: Disables slime block bouncing for players only. Vanilla behavior for all other entities is fully preserved.
carpet.rule.slimeBlockNoPlayerSlowdown.n: Hardened Slime Block: No Player Slowdown
carpet.rule.slimeBlockNoPlayerSlowdown.d: Disables slime block slowdown for players only. Vanilla behavior for all other entities is fully preserved.
